test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?
They will announce the results tomorrow.

options.text: The results will be announced tomorrow.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They will announce the results tomorrow."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the results" at the beginning of the sentence.
 
• Change the active verb form "will announce" to "will be announced" (future simple passive).
 
• Ensure the time phrase "tomorrow" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The results will be announced tomorrow."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The results are announced tomorrow." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive instead of future simple passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"The results will announced tomorrow." – Grammatically incorrect (missing "be" in the passive structure).
 
• **Option 4: **"The results were announced tomorrow." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive instead of future simple passive).
